title: Truth Disclosure
subtitle: Test your grasp of Truth Disclosure — E.B.S. packages, Whitehat lockdown, bloodline and vaccine exposure, tribunals, and the bridge to solar-family arrival.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Truth Disclosure is the Phase Seven and Eight climax that shatters false reality through E.B.S. packages, protective lockdown, and tribunals. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Truth Disclosure deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Sequenced shock becomes liberation—and Resonating Sols help carry the newly awakened into total resonance as crystalline reality and true solar families emerge.

questions.question: What do Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent in the Great Awakening?

options.label: A
options.text: The opening of the Great Awakening, a quiet period in which the elites are warned in private and given a chance to step down before the public is told anything.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent the climax of the Great Awakening, designed to permanently shatter the parasitic illusion through absolute truth and secure the realm for ascension processes.

options.label: B
options.text: A period in which the Cabal regains control of the narrative and the illusion is restored, before a later attempt at disclosure is made in the next cycle of the realm.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent the climax of the Great Awakening, designed to permanently shatter the parasitic illusion through absolute truth and secure the realm for ascension processes.

options.label: C
options.text: A plan that was called off before it began, after the Alliance decided that the grid could be stabilized for disclosure without any further military phases or tribunals.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent the climax of the Great Awakening, designed to permanently shatter the parasitic illusion through absolute truth and secure the realm for ascension processes.

options.label: D
options.text: The climax of the Great Awakening, a controlled operation that permanently shatters the parasitic illusion through absolute truth and secures the realm for ascension.
options.rationale: Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent the climax of the Great Awakening, designed to permanently shatter the parasitic illusion through absolute truth and secure the realm for ascension processes.

questions.hint: Climax operation using absolute truth to secure the realm for ascension.

questions.question: What does the Truth Disclosure sequence do to the masses’ false reality?

options.rationale: Core work is dismantling false reality and proving planetary hijacking through evidentiary broadcasts.

options.label: B
options.text: It only restores NPC media twisting with no military or light-force stabilization role.
options.rationale: Cabal NPC media is cut off; only the military emergency channel broadcasts truth.

options.label: C
options.text: It systematically dismantles false reality, replacing a tightly controlled global narrative with undeniable proof of planetary hijacking.
options.rationale: The sequence systematically dismantles the false reality of the masses, replacing a tightly controlled global narrative with undeniable proof of planetary hijacking.

options.label: D
options.text: It permanently strengthens the controlled global narrative so planetary hijacking stays forever hidden.
options.rationale: Disclosure replaces controlled narrative with undeniable proof of planetary hijacking.

questions.hint: Replace tightly controlled global narrative with proof of planetary hijacking.

questions.question: How do light forces stabilize the physical and energetic grid during disclosure?

options.label: A

options.rationale: By severing old communication networks, executing coordinated military lockdown, and broadcasting irrefutable evidence of elite crimes, light forces stabilize the physical and energetic grid.

options.label: B
options.text: By only delaying all truth until after solar families land without any grid stabilization first.
options.rationale: Disclosure protocol paves the way for solar-family arrival after grid stabilization and truth absorption.

options.label: C
options.text: By only posting anonymous rumors with no network cut, lockdown, or irrefutable evidence stream.
options.rationale: Disclosure uses absolute control: communications cut, military lockdown, and sequenced evidentiary packages.

options.label: D
options.text: By restoring Cabal media fully and cancelling all military lockdowns and elite-crime evidence.
options.rationale: Old networks are severed and elite crimes are broadcast under protective military stabilization.

questions.hint: Name network severing, military lockdown, and elite-crime broadcasts.

options.rationale: Strategic end-state includes original crystalline reality emerging and true solar families landing safely.

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Permanent thickening of the 3D overlay and permanent ban on any solar-family public arrival.
options.rationale: Protocol enables overlay collapse and safe public solar-family arrival, not permanent thickening.

options.text: Total collapse of the 3D overlay and the safe, public arrival of the true solar families.
options.rationale: This precise disclosure protocol paves the way for total collapse of the 3D overlay and the safe, public arrival of the true solar families.
